name: Passports & Visas
author: Luffy
description: Manage passports, visas, visa applications and border crossings, with optional Hong Kong and Macao permit, endorsement and port tracking. 管理护照、签证、签证申请和出入境记录，并可选启用港澳通行证、签注及口岸管理。

settings.label: Enable Hong Kong & Macao permit management
settings.hint: Adds separate permit and Hong Kong/Macao crossing records to the plugin. 在插件中添加独立的港澳通行证和港澳出入境记录管理。
